pc_complianceNote_ph: e.g. lithium batteries with UN38.3/MSDS, or other regulatory requirements
pc_err_compliance_note: Describe the requirement when 'Other restrictions' is selected
pc_comp_export_control_hint: Export-controlled items/technology, sanctioned countries or restricted parties
pc_comp_dangerous_hint: Lithium batteries, chemicals, flammables; special transport/customs rules
pc_comp_medical_hint: Medical devices, drugs or diagnostic equipment requiring registration/licence
pc_comp_dual_use_hint: Items usable for civil and military purposes, e.g. high-performance sensors, drones
pc_comp_other_hint: Other regulatory requirements not covered above; describe them in the note
pc_authorizePublish: I authorize Yunjing OS to process, translate, display, publish and match this requirement (incl. attachments)
pc_wb_withdraw_confirm: Withdraw this requirement? Published copies will be removed from search and plaza.

pc_bflow_need_info: Yunjing requested more materials — revise per the note and resubmit.
pc_bflow_verified_done: ✓ Entity verified: you can formally publish (authorization signing & verification still required at publish).
pc_bflow_restricted: Entity is restricted; contact the platform.
pc_auth_hint_body: Submitting confirms the final version and generates the numbered authorization letter. You will be taken to the letter page: print → sign & seal → upload scan → confirm online. Once Yunjing verifies, it publishes automatically and matching starts.
pc_auth_hint_warning: Important: resubmitting after edits increments the version; signed authorizations become void and must be re-signed.
pc_bauthdoc_hint: Upload a letter of authorization if you procure on behalf of a third party
pc_installNeeds_hint: Tick the services the supplier must include in the quotation; none means delivery only.

pc_install_training_hint: Training: operation and maintenance (days/headcount in attachment)
pc_guar_note_ph: e.g. valid until 30 days after delivery
pc_guarantees_hint: Select required guarantees; fill form, percentage/amount and validity/release for each.
pc_cert_hint: Select from the certification dictionary; use "Other" for items not listed.
pc_err_cert_custom: Please enter the custom certification name
pc_incoterm_hint: Incoterms must be paired with a version and a named place, e.g. FOB Shanghai or DDP Nairobi; a bare FOB does not fix cost or risk transfer.
pc_err_incoterm_version: Select an Incoterms version when a term is chosen
pc_err_incoterm_place: Enter the named place/port when a term is chosen
pc_batchNote: Batch details (batches, frequency, quantity per batch)
pc_bexternalrules: Applicable external procurement rules (World Bank / UN / government)
pc_autosave_hint: Draft is saved automatically as you type
pc_err_delivery: Please fill in delivery country and city
pc_err_deadline: Please fill in the quote deadline
pc_err_authorize: Please confirm Yunjing OS may publish the requirement
pc_risk_title: Risk hints (self-check; not a substitute for Yunjing verification)

pc_risk_free_email: Free email domain used; a corporate email is recommended
pc_risk_agent_auth_missing: Agent procurement without an authorization document
pc_risk_external_rules: External procurement rules apply; extra review required
pc_dedup_hint: Matches existing buyer records below; please confirm
pc_risk_email_domain_mismatch: Email domain does not match the website
pc_auth_note: Confirming constitutes a reliable electronic signature (account, time, IP and file hash are recorded); the authorization lapses when the demand version changes.
pc_auth_verified_hint: ✓ Authorization verified; publication is pending or complete. Re-sign after re-submitting a revised demand.
pc_auth_load_failed: Failed to load authorization status. Please retry.
pc_review_waiting: Submitted and awaiting verification (usually within 1 business day)
pc_review_overtime: More than 2 days without verification — please contact the platform
pc_review_autorefresh: This page refreshes the status every 25 seconds
pc_published_hint: Published to the demand plaza; supplier matching has started
pc_autosave_error: Autosave failed — use “Save draft” to retry
pc_close_reason_expired: Closed automatically at the quote deadline
pc_bhint_orgname: Must match the business licence exactly — it appears in the authorization letter and identifies your organisation.
pc_bhint_orgname_rename: Changing the name triggers re-verification and voids any signed authorization — you will need to sign again.
pc_bhint_role: Decides whether an agent-authorization document is required: needed only if you buy on behalf of others.
pc_bhint_regno: Used for duplicate detection and authenticity checks — one registration number cannot be registered twice.
pc_bhint_license: Reviewers use this to confirm the organisation exists; replacing the file triggers re-verification.
pc_bhint_email: Platform and verification notices go here; a domain mismatch with your website raises a check flag.
pc_bhint_website: Optional. Only used to cross-check your email domain; leave empty to skip that check.
pc_bhint_contact: The single contact reviewers use when they need documents or clarification.
pc_brules_help: Select the rules that apply when funding comes from an external institution, such as a World Bank loan, a UN agency programme, or a government procurement budget. Reviewers will check sanctions lists, conflicts of interest and origin requirements. Leave blank if none apply.
pc_brules_other_ph: e.g. World Bank Procurement Regulations 2016, loan no. 8xxxx
pc_bhint_rules: Optional. Selecting or entering a rule sends this buyer to manual compliance review. Submission is not blocked.
pc_bauthdoc_na: You are the end buyer, so no agent-authorization document is needed — it is required only for authorized agents.
pc_gone_title: This procurement request no longer exists
pc_gone_desc: It may have been withdrawn or deleted, or the link has expired.
